apihelp-glowthreadpost-summary: Post a comment, or a reply to a comment, on a page.
apihelp-glowthreadpost-param-pageid: ID of the page to comment on.
apihelp-glowthreadpost-param-text: Comment text, as plain text. URLs are recognised when the comment is shown. To mention a user, write <@ID> with their user ID, for example <@42>. A typed @Name stays plain text.
apihelp-glowthreadpost-param-replyto: ID of the comment to reply to. It must be on the same page.
apihelp-glowthreadreact-summary: Like a comment or take a like back. Setting the same value again changes nothing.
apihelp-glowthreadreact-param-value: 1 to like, 0 to take the like back.
apihelp-glowthreadreact-example-unlike: Take back the like on comment 7.
apihelp-glowthreadreport-summary: Report a comment to the moderators. Each user can report a comment once.
apihelp-glowthreadreport-param-reason: Why the comment is reported. The wiki may turn some reasons off.
apihelp-glowthreaddelete-param-reason: Optional reason, shown in the comment log.
apihelp-glowthreadmoderate-summary: Moderate comments: approve, delete, restore, erase, pin, unpin, or dismiss their reports. Each comment succeeds or fails on its own.
apihelp-glowthreadmoderate-param-do: The action. undo reverses earlier actions exactly (see logids). erase needs the glowthread-erase right and only applies to deleted comments, and cannot be undone.
apihelp-glowthreadmoderate-param-reason: Reason, shown in the comment log.
apihelp-glowthreadmoderate-example-undo: Undo the actions of log entries 120 and 121 on comments 7 and 8.
apihelp-glowthreadmoderate-param-logids: With do=undo: the log ID of the action to undo for each comment in ids, in the same order (the logId of an earlier result).
apihelp-glowthreadpage-summary: Open, lock or turn off comments on a page.
apihelp-glowthreadpage-param-state: open: anyone with the rights can comment. locked: comments stay readable, nobody can add new ones. disabled: the comment section is hidden.
apihelp-glowthreadpage-param-reason: Reason, shown in the comment log.
apihelp-glowthreadfiltertest-summary: Run the comment word filter on sample text without saving anything.
apihelp-glowthreadfiltertest-param-rules: Draft rules to test instead of the current [[MediaWiki:GlowThread-filter]].
apihelp-glowthreadfiltertest-example-cur: Test text against the current rules.
apihelp-glowthreadfiltertest-example-dra: Test text against a draft rule.
apihelp-glowthreadsettings-summary: Change comment settings that the wiki configuration allows to change on-wiki.
apihelp-glowthreadsettings-param-setting: JSON object of setting names and new values. null resets a setting to the configured default.
apihelp-glowthreadsettings-param-reason: Reason, shown in the comment log.
apihelp-glowthreadsettings-example-set: Hold comments from accounts younger than 48 hours.
apihelp-flowthread-summary: Read-only replacement for FlowThread's API, answered by GlowThread for old clients. Use the GlowThread REST routes and the glowthread* modules instead.
apihelp-flowthread-extended-description: type=list lists the visible comments of a page in FlowThread's format. type=listall lists comments of all pages for moderators. All other types are refused: FlowThread has been replaced by GlowThread.
apihelp-flowthread-param-type: What to do. Only list and listall work. The others belonged to FlowThread and are refused.
apihelp-flowthread-param-pageid: Page whose comments to list (type=list, required), or to filter by (type=listall).
apihelp-flowthread-param-limit: Number of top-level comments (type=list) or comments (type=listall) to list.
apihelp-flowthread-param-filter: type=listall: all, deleted, spam (waiting for review) or reported comments. Without it, visible comments.
apihelp-flowthread-param-title: type=listall: page to filter by, when pageid is not given.
apihelp-flowthread-param-user: type=listall: only comments by this user.
apihelp-flowthread-param-keyword: type=listall: only comments containing this text (case-sensitive).
apihelp-flowthread-param-dir: type=listall: newest first (older) or oldest first (newer).
apihelp-flowthread-param-postid: Ignored. Used by FlowThread's write types, which are refused.
apihelp-flowthread-param-content: Ignored. Used by FlowThread's write types, which are refused.
apihelp-flowthread-param-wikitext: Ignored. Used by FlowThread's write types, which are refused.
apihelp-flowthread-example-list: List the newest comments on page 1.
apihelp-flowthread-example-listall: List reported comments on all pages (moderators).
apierror-glowthread-legacy-readonly: FlowThread has been replaced by GlowThread. This interface is read-only: post, like, report and moderate with the GlowThread comment box or its API (action=glowthreadpost and related modules).
